name: Rust
exports_detected: pub fn / pub async fn / pub unsafe fn
pub struct / pub enum / pub trait
pub type / pub const / pub static / pub mod
description: Detects all pub and pub(crate) declarations. Strips raw string literals, regular strings, and comments before matching to avoid false positives inside string data.

detection_rules.title: Public item declarations
detection_rules.description: Matches pub (or pub(crate)) followed by any of: fn, struct, enum, trait, type, const, static, mod. Handles async and unsafe modifiers.

detection_rules.title: pub(crate) items
detection_rules.description: Crate-internal public items are also captured, since they represent the module's API surface within the crate.
detection_rules.example_code:
pub(crate) fn internal_fn() {}
pub(crate) struct InternalStruct {}

detection_rules.title: String literal stripping
detection_rules.description: Raw strings (r#"..."#), regular strings, and char literals are stripped before regex matching to prevent false positives from pub declarations inside string data.

test_pattern_examples.explanation: Inline test modules — exports inside are excluded

---
module: auth
version: 1
status: stable
files:
  - src/auth.rs
---

## Purpose

Handles JWT-based authentication.

## Public API

| Item | Kind | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `create_auth` | fn | Creates a new Auth instance |
| `AuthService` | struct | Auth service type |
| `AuthStatus` | enum | Active or Expired states |
| `DEFAULT_TTL` | const | Default session TTL in seconds |

## Change Log

| Date | Change |
|------|--------|
| 2026-01-01 | Initial |
caveats: Procedural macros that generate pub items (e.g. #[derive], custom macros) are not detected.
Re-exports via pub use are not captured as distinct symbols.
Items inside conditional compilation blocks (#[cfg(...)]) are included unless the block is #[cfg(test)].
